name: 46-google-thought-signatures-off
description: Gemini 3 thought signatures with the config OFF ('gemini.thoughtSignatures': false), which is the only thing that can stop the first branch at :582. Model 'gemini-3.5-flash' (no /-image/), so the third branch at :589 cannot fire either. A model turn carrying a stored `signature` must therefore get NO thoughtSignature, while the mandatory functionCall bypass at :586-588 still applies -- the two conditions are an if/elif chain, and the bypass is not gated on the config. The last model turn holds only inlineData, which never takes the bypass on a non-image model. Expected contents: [user[text], model[text 'thinking' with no thoughtSignature], user[text], model[functionCall+bypass], user[text], model[inlineData, no bypass]].
